title: Listen and choose 3.2
role: Guide telling the history and folklore of a place
can_do: I can tell the history of a place using the past simple and the passive.
I can retell a local legend with narrative tenses.

items.prompt: How long did the building take?
items.explanation: It was begun in the twelfth century and finished two hundred years later.

items.prompt: How was the lake created, according to the legend?
items.explanation: The giant wept for his lost love.

items.prompt: What is true about the valley?

options.text: People lived there for centuries before

items.explanation: It had been inhabited for centuries before the first houses.
